SELECT json_build_object(
  'def', (SELECT pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgname = 'trg_recalc_score_on_history' LIMIT 1),
  'fn', (SELECT left(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid), 1500) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid WHERE t.tgname = 'trg_recalc_score_on_history' LIMIT 1)
) AS r
